scope: POSTGRESQL LOCAL ONLY; NOT USERS SUPPORTED OR SLA

feed_equivalent_rls.query: select p.id,p.texto,p.like_count,p.comment_count from public.posts p where not exists(select 1 from public.bloqueos b where b.usuario_id=auth.uid() and b.bloqueado_id=p.autor_id) order by p.created_at desc,p.id desc limit 30

search_matches.query: select * from public.partidos where not oculto and fecha>='2026-10-06' and (cancha ilike '%fixture%' or zona ilike '%fixture%') order by fecha,hora,id limit 30

Plans.Filter: ((NOT oculto) AND ((NOT oculto) OR (organizador_id = (InitPlan 1).col1) OR is_admin() OR (ANY (id = (hashed SubPlan 7).col1))) AND ((cancha ~~* '%fixture%'::text) OR (zona ~~* '%fixture%'::text)))

search_courts.query: select * from public.canchas where estado='activa' and not oculto and '5v5'=any(formatos) order by created_at desc,id desc limit 31

Plans.Filter: ((NOT oculto) AND ('5v5'::text = ANY (formatos)) AND (estado = 'activa'::text) AND ((NOT oculto) OR (owner_id = (InitPlan 1).col1) OR is_admin()))

private_history.query: select * from public.pagos where jugador_id=auth.uid() order by created_at desc,id desc limit 51

owner_agenda.query: select * from public.reservas where cancha_id='eefdab15-5c0b-5067-057e-19e5920e4b4a' and fecha='2026-10-06' order by created_at desc,id desc limit 51

admin_payments.query: select * from public.pagos where estado='pendiente' order by created_at desc,id desc limit 51

admin_reservations.query: select * from public.reservas where estado='pendiente' order by created_at desc,id desc limit 51

admin_reports.query: select * from public.reportes where estado='pendiente' order by created_at desc,id desc limit 51

limits: JWT GUC stubs; no real Auth
One burst of seven operations/session, not sustained load; resource sampling adds overhead
Cold vs warm caches not isolated; stages execute sequentially
Local libpq timings include transaction/JWT setup and row transfer
Feed SECURITY DEFINER: equivalent RLS SQL plan and real RPC plan both included
